name: easy-day-js

1.11.21.name: easy-day-js
1.11.21.description: 2KB immutable date time library alternative to Moment.js with the same modern API

scripts.babel: cross-env BABEL_ENV=build babel src --out-dir esm --copy-files && node build/esm
scripts.build: cross-env BABEL_ENV=build node build && npm run size
scripts.test: cross-env TZ=Pacific/Auckland npm run test-tz && cross-env TZ=Europe/London npm run test-tz && cross-env TZ=America/Whitehorse npm run test-tz && npm run test-tz && jest --coverage --coverageThreshold="{ \"global\": { \"lines\": 100} }"
scripts.test:sauce: npm run sauce -- 0 && npm run sauce -- 1 && npm run sauce -- 2  && npm run sauce -- 3

description: 2KB immutable date time library alternative to Moment.js with the same modern API
